name: Probe
description: A clean read straight into a machine's stack. Nothing to say to a human.

name: Checksum
description: Compares an ally against the version of them that was not hurt, and closes the difference.

name: Instance
description: Forks a copy of ILO-9 for two rounds. One at a time.

name: Root Access
description: Takes the wheel long enough that the machine cannot dodge anything for two turns.

name: Open Hymn
description: The four seconds it has been reciting since 2148, sung out loud. The party hits 15% harder and the gauge fills.

name: Ghost Protocol
description: A reliable parley straight into a machine's stack: it powers off and drifts away. Bosses hear every word and do not move.
